coordinateSystem.source: Blender exporter maps (x,y,z) to glTF (x,z,-y); do not rotate cabinet again

camera.notes: For another aspect, horizontalSpan=verticalSpan*aspect. Constrain composition container rather than showing whole phone aspect in 3D. Keep width>=5.55 scene units.

badgePlacement.anchor: world-space bottom center of normalized, upright, front-facing model bounding box
steps: Use existing badge adapter to orient each source model; do not assume raw source GLB up/front
Compute full world bounds after updating matrixWorld
Scale uniformly by targetVisualWidth / bounds width
Translate bottom-center of bounds to badgeBottomCenter
Do not apply parent and child transforms twice
badgePlacement.defaultAssignments: Example only: use actual grants and persisted stable IDs, never assume all three owned.

runtimeRecommendation.environment: Reuse existing clearsky environment/HDR if suitable; evaluate exposure on device
runtimeRecommendation.lights: Use hemisphere/environment + one soft key. Offline area-light watts are not Three.js intensity values. Avoid three shadow-casting lights.
runtimeRecommendation.shadows: Not baked into supplied GLB. Use baked contact AO/shadow texture as optional production step or one low-resolution contact shadow.
runtimeRecommendation.glass: Two side fins use transmission; switch to non-transmissive tinted transparent approximation on low tier.
